before.section: Abstract
before.match: We use public ASVspoof~2021~DF score files from four model-author releases and four organizer baselines; recomputed equal-error rates (EERs) match the values reported for these releases at reported precision. We refit EER thresholds under trial and joint speaker--attack resampling and construct simultaneous bands for all 28 EER differences.

after.match: Using public scores from eight ASVspoof~2021~DF systems, we compare resampling individual trials with resampling observed speakers and spoof attacks, keeping detector comparisons paired and refitting EER thresholds.
